blurb: Experience the best of Niagara Falls on this full-day tour from Toronto. Travel in a comfortable motor coach with a knowledgeable guide along the scenic Niagara Parkway to Horseshoe Falls, visit Table Rock Welcome Centre, and pause at the Whirlpool Rapids lookout. In summer, you can upgrade to include the legendary Niagara City Cruises boat ride (seasonal from approx. May to November - will be substituted with Niagara Takes Flight when not in operation); Journey Behind the Falls is also available year-round. Enjoy free time to explore on your own, plus an optional Canadian-themed lunch at Maple Leaf Place with maple syrup, fudge, and chocolate tastings along the Maple trail. Beat the crowds, live commentary, and round-trip transport, it’s perfect for families, couples, and solo travellers year-round returning to Toronto by 5:30pm
